test_objective: Check that the queried entity by id can be returned in a GeoJSON format

test_cases.name: 018_05_01 Simplified
test_cases.doc: Check that the queried entity by id can be returned in a GeoJSON format
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/geo+json' and
    Query Parameter: options set to 'keyValues' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"'
}

test_cases.name: 018_05_02 Normalized
test_cases.doc: Check that the queried entity by id can be returned in a GeoJSON format
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/geo+json' and
    Query Parameter: options set to '${EMPTY}' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"'
}
